headline: Abu Dhabi Property Transactions Surge to AED 171.26 Billion
summary: Abu Dhabi recorded property transactions worth AED 171.26 billion as sales volumes doubled. This points to robust sector growth in the emirate.
why: It shows a massive surge in property transaction values and sales volume in Abu Dhabi.
impact_reason: Highlights surging sales values and strong market activity.

headline: Abu Dhabi Property Values Jump 76 Percent to AED 171.26 Billion
